text.author: Aditya
text.abp1: I'm a video editor with 3 years of experience. I turn raw footage into YouTube videos, reels and ads that people actually finish.
text.abp2: I care about clean cuts, strong pacing and color that supports the story. Send me the footage and I'll take it from first cut to final export.
text.ctatitle: Got footage? Let's make it worth watching.
text.tagline: Video editing and color grading by Aditya Gautam.
